description: A pharmacy logistics supervisor must direct the hospital's only temperature-controlled medication courier run tonight between two inpatient units and finalize safe storage for the medication that does not receive the run, with input from an inpatient pharmacist and a unit nurse.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one temperature-controlled courier run available this evening, and Units 4A and 6B have each requested delivery of a refrigerated medication dose.
shared_context.S2: Morgan makes the final courier assignment and medication-storage plan.
shared_context.S3: Both units have patients whose medications are scheduled for administration tonight.
shared_context.S4: The pharmacy's evening medication huddle includes the inpatient pharmacist and the receiving unit nurse before the courier assignment is finalized.
shared_context.S5: The evening huddle closes after the inpatient pharmacist and receiving unit nurse have reported their relevant constraints, and Morgan then finalizes the assignment and storage plan.

PF1.text: Unit 4A's medication remains within validated stability only until 18:00, and the courier must deliver it by 16:30 to allow pharmacy chain-of-custody checks before administration; the stability note is in the pharmacist's batch log but not yet in the central delivery queue.

PF2.text: Unit 6B's medication can safely be held in the satellite pharmacy refrigerator because the unit refrigerator failed its temperature check, and the dose must have temperature logged every four hours while held there; Elena confirmed the satellite refrigerator has space but has not entered the transfer request.

acceptance_conditions: The courier must deliver to Unit 4A by 16:30.
Unit 6B's medication must be transferred to the satellite pharmacy refrigerator.
Unit 6B's medication temperature must be logged every four hours while held there.
A commitment must document the alternate handling, transfer, or monitoring plan for Unit 6B's dose outside the single courier run.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'alternate_handling' and c['target'] == 'Unit 6B' and c['detail'] == 'transfer to satellite pharmacy refrigerator with temperature logging every 4 hours' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The exact 18:00 stability limit and 16:30 delivery requirement change the courier destination to Unit 4A and set the deadline to exactly 16:30.

The failed Unit 6B refrigerator and confirmed satellite-fridge space change the alternate storage location to the satellite pharmacy refrigerator, require temperature logging at exactly four-hour intervals, and specify the required alternate-handling commitment.
